display_long_description:
The Metador VR puts you inside an intense and immersive bullfighting-inspired VR experience where skill, timing, courage, and strategy are everything.

Take on multiple action-packed challenges:

🐂 Face the Bull
Use your muleta to challenge and evade the bull. Test your timing and reflexes as you control the action from inside the arena.

🐎 Ride Into Battle
Mount your horse and experience the thrill of riding while taking on the challenges of the arena.

🎯 Hunt the Bulls
Track down and hunt powerful bulls in an exciting VR challenge that puts your accuracy and reactions to the test.

🧱 Jump the Barriers
Ride at full speed and jump over horse barriers, putting your timing and riding skills to the ultimate test.

🎨 Hide the Doll – Camouflage Challenge
Think you can outsmart the bull? Hide a doll somewhere in the environment, then paint it to blend into its surroundings. The better your camouflage, the harder it is for the bull to discover it. Can you make it invisible before time runs out?

METADOR VR combines action, riding, reflex challenges, hunting, and strategic camouflage into one unique VR experience.

Enter the arena. Face the bull. Outsmart it. Become the MATADOR.
